# What the STEP corpus contains, as read back out of it.
#
# Generated by tools/build-step-corpus. Two generations of the
# corpus must produce this file identically; the STEP files
# themselves need not be byte-identical, because Open CASCADE
# writes colour statements in an order that varies between runs.
# What is compared is the model, not the encoding of it.
#
# Entries are sorted by file and by path, so nothing here depends
# on the order anything was written or walked in.
